about.title: About
bio: Focused on designing and shipping enterprise AI Agent systems. Built a full Agent platform around LLMs — covering RAG retrieval, middleware orchestration, memory systems, and quality evaluation — serving multiple internal business scenarios.
Core stack is Python + LangGraph, with Elasticsearch hybrid search, vLLM model serving, and Langfuse observability. Built this blog with Next.js on the side to document engineering insights.
about.timeline2026Desc: Building a personal tech blog to share Agent engineering and RAG system practices.
about.timeline2025Desc: Designed and shipped a multi-assistant Agent system covering RAG pipelines, middleware framework, memory system, and evaluation.
